### Added

- (agent-platform, muster) [Connect ChatGPT in the sign-in dialog, and a connect prompt in the agent chat](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3213) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Your profile's new `Connections` section and the MCP sign-in dialog connect your own ChatGPT subscription: the portal opens OpenAI's page and shows the code to enter. A session with an agent on that model shows `Connect your ChatGPT subscription to talk to this agent.` until you have. Needs a muster that offers the ChatGPT connection.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [The minimum disk size's description names GiB](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3211) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — In the workspace editor, the minimum disk size's description says `…smaller than this many GiB`, so a screen reader names the unit that is drawn after the number.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.17.9...v3.18.0
